name: vscode-updater
description: Automatically update VS Code on Linux

vscode-updater.installPath.description: Custom installation directory for VS Code. Leave empty to auto-detect.

vscode-updater.autoBackup.description: Automatically backup the current installation before updating.

vscode-updater.checkInterval.description: How often to check for updates in days (default: 1). Ignored if vscode-updater.enabled is false.

vscode-updater.enabled.description: Master switch for automatic update checks. When false, no startup check, periodic checks, or notifications are triggered. The manual 'Check for VSCode Updates' command still works.

vscode-updater.checkOnStartup.description: Perform an update check when VS Code starts up. Only applies when vscode-updater.enabled is true.

vscode-updater.channel.description: VS Code release channel to check and download.

vscode-updater.flavour.description: VS Code flavour. Use 'other' to provide custom update and test URLs.

vscode-updater.customUpdateBaseUrl.description: Base URL for update downloads when flavour is 'other'. Example: https://update.example.com

vscode-updater.customReleasesUrl.description: Full URL for releases list when flavour is 'other'. Example: https://update.example.com/api/releases/stable

vscode-updater.customBinaryName.description: Binary name to restart when flavour is 'other'. Leave empty to use 'code'.

vscode-updater.debug.deleteDownloadedArc.description: Delete the downloaded archive after updating. Set to false to keep the archive for debugging.

vscode-updater.debug.keepFailedFolder.description: When update fails, keep the new folder with a .BAD suffix instead of restoring from backup. Useful for debugging.

vscode-updater.logLevel.description: Verbosity level for the extension log in the Output panel (least to most verbose: info < debug < trace). Default is info — use debug for detailed troubleshooting or trace for every internal step.

vscode-updater.tempDir.description: Custom directory for temporary extraction and downloads. Leave empty to use the system temp directory. Use this to avoid cross-device issues.

vscode-updater.tarTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for tar extraction (default: 600000 = 10 minutes). Increase for very slow network filesystems or large archives.

vscode-updater.mvTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for mv operations during installation replacement (default: 600000 = 10 minutes). Increase for cross-device moves on slow storage.
